name: @mandate/portfolio
description: Phase 7F: the Portfolio Mandate and multi-agent coordination layer above Mandate Core. A principal-signed PORTFOLIO_MANDATE.V1 with typed resources and allocation modes, parent-to-child authority derivation, a deterministic authority-free Mandate Room, a Portfolio Verifier, compilation into Core grants and reservation through the unchanged control engine, and deterministic receipts. Offline; no network, clock or key.
